title: Backend Developer (Java + Spring Boot)
description:
**Company Description**

Netcomm IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. provides IT solutions and consulting services to multinational organizations, enterprises, and startups. We help clients modernize applications and build scalable, secure, and efficient technology platforms. Our teams work closely with clients across industries to deliver solutions that support their business goals.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Backend Developer with strong Java and Spring Boot expertise to design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs for enterprise applications.

In this full-time, on-site role in Chennai, you will build Spring Boot microservices, integrate databases and third-party services, and improve application performance and reliability. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, participate in code reviews and technical discussions, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver maintainable solutions within an Agile environment.

**Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience in Java backend development, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming, JVM fundamentals, memory management, and exception handling.
* Proficiency in Java collections, generics, and appropriate use of List, Set, Map, and concurrent collections.
* Practical experience with Java 8+ features, including lambda expressions, functional interfaces, Streams, Optional, and method references.
* Familiarity with modern Java features introduced across Java 11–21, such as records, sealed classes, text blocks, and pattern matching.
* Understanding of multithreading and concurrency, including synchronization, executors, Callable, and CompletableFuture.
* Hands-on experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot, including dependency injection, REST controllers, transaction management, AOP, and logging.
* Experience designing and maintaining microservices and RESTful APIs.
* Working knowledge of Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Understanding of Java serialization and related concepts.
* Familiarity with Git and build tools such as Maven or Gradle.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an understanding of secure coding, performance optimization, and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in Agile/Scrum teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Added Advantage**

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated backend testing.

**How to Apply**

Send your updated CV to
**info@netcommitsolutions.com**
with the subject “
**Application – Java Spring Boot Developer – Chennai**
”. Please include your relevant experience, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.

title: Java Backend Developer IRC304349
description:
**Description**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group company, is a trusted partner in design, data, and digital engineering for the world’s largest and most innovative companies. Since our inception in 2000, we have been at the forefront of the digital revolution, helping to create some of the most widely used digital products and experiences. Our purpose is to positively impact society and the planet through cutting-edge technology. Together with our clients, we are engineering impact through intelligent products, platforms, and services that are designed for desirability, engineered for excellence, and curated for intelligence.
  
  
**Requirements**
Tech Skills – Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Azure, Kafka
  
  
  

* Should be strong in Core JAVA and Design Principles
* Should be very strong in J2EE with Spring, JPA and Hibernate
* Should be very strong in Spring Boot with RESTful Webservices and Microservices
* Should have working experience on RDBMS / MySQL databases
* Should be proficient in documenting the process and code using standard tools like POSTMAN, Swagger etc.,
* Should be proficient with Azure services
* Basic understanding of Caching (Redis) and Search/Index Platform (Elastic Search)

Job responsibilities
  
  
**Minimum 8 Years Of Software Development Experience**

* Work closely with Managers (Technical and Product) to define and plan projects and activities
* Develop and implement an architecture strategy
* Facilitate team collaboration towards software engineering best practices, and solutions that meet customer needs
* Ensuring high quality code is produced and maintained through code review and frequent defect prevention activity
* Work closely in small teams to create well integrated products in short design cycles with good documentation and reusable artifacts
* Agile/ Scrum/Kanban experience

What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
